name: agent-trust-sdk
description: Trustflow workspace: @trustflow/sdk, @trustflow/cli, @trustflow/mcp-server, @trustflow/next-plugin, and @trustflow/vercel-plugin. Hosted registry: Trustflow Systems.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk build && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 --filter "./packages/*" --filter "!@trustflow/sdk" build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk build && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 --filter "./packages/*" --filter "!@trustflow/sdk" typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk build && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 --filter "./packages/*" test && node --test scripts/launch-readiness.test.mjs
scripts.smoke: corepack pnpm --filter @trustflow/sdk build && corepack pnpm --filter @trustflow/cli build && corepack pnpm --filter @trustflow/cli smoke
